sales_hooks: SMIC is the only advanced node foundry available to Chinese AI chip designers — every Huawei Ascend chip and CXMT HBM-equivalent die is fabbed here, making SMIC's capacity the bottleneck for China's AI buildout.
SMIC N+2 yield improvement is a technology risk signal — as their DUV-based 7nm equivalent matures, it reduces China's AI chip gap with the West, impacting global HBM demand forecasts for China.

SMIC's 28nm+ expansion (funded by China government) is serving automotive/IoT — this capacity does not compete with AI HBM, but the revenue signals SMIC's overall financial health and investment capacity.
Export control changes affecting SMIC's equipment purchases (ASML DUV, applied materials) are a leading indicator of China's domestic AI capability trajectory.
